Gemini said

InfraCloud Technologies is a specialized, niche cloud-native product and consulting services company. Founded in 2016, it is widely recognized for its expertise in Kubernetes, cloud-native architecture, DevSecOps, and modern AI/GPU infrastructure engineering.

Key Company Overview

  • Headquarters: Pune, Maharashtra, India

  • Founders: Girish Shilamkar (CEO) and Vishal Biyani (CTO)

  • Core Focus: Building AI & GPU Cloud infrastructure, cloud-native transformation, application modernization, and SRE/DevOps engineering.

  • Ecosystem Contributions: InfraCloud actively contributes to open-source projects under the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) and organizes community initiatives like local Kubernetes & Cloud Native Meetups (KubeDay/KubeCon participation).

Core Offerings & Services

  1. AI & GPU Cloud Infrastructure:

    • Helping SaaS and enterprise companies build, manage, and optimize GPU-backed cloud setups tailored for AI/ML workloads.

  2. Kubernetes & Cloud Native Adoption:

    • Container orchestration, platform engineering, migration from monolithic systems to microservices, and Service Mesh implementations (e.g., Istio, Linkerd).

  3. DevOps & DevSecOps Engineering:

    • Designing automated CI/CD pipelines, GitOps implementations, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), and embedding zero-trust security into dev lifecycles.

  4. Observability & SRE Managed Services:

    • Implementing full-stack observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) and providing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) support for high-availability systems.

  5. Engagement Models:

    • Architecture consulting, managed infrastructure services, fixed-scope projects, and remote team extension.

Market Positioning & Culture

  • Early Mover Advantage: InfraCloud was among the early cloud-native niche consultancies in India, establishing itself before mainstream enterprise adopters shifted to Kubernetes.

  • Remote-Friendly Culture: Operates with a flexible, remote-first work environment, attracting high-skilled engineers in DevOps, Go, Python, and Cloud Architecture.
